1.f1.name: Generous Cut
1.f1.text: Tithe Cut gives 0.1 more blood per MP it tears out, per rank.
1.f1._not: engine-dev 2026-11-17 (Redtithe eşlemesi; Ömer onayı bekler, open-questions Q-NEW Redtithe): MP çalma payı (gainRatio +%10) -> MP başına kan (bloodPerMp 2 x %10 = +0,2). Eski metin: Mana Steal gives you 10% more of the burned MP per rank.

1.f2.name: Deep Pockets
1.f2.text: Tithe Cut +3.25% damage per rank against enemies above half MP.

1.f3.name: Deep Cut
1.f3.text: Tithe Cut also tears out 1.25% of the target's max MP per rank.

1.n0.name: Prying Blade
1.n0.text: Tithe Cut removes one random buff from its target.

1.r.name: Bare Steel
1.r.text: Tithe Cut deals 0.75% increased damage per rank against enemies with no buffs.

1.ea.name: Siphon Vein
1.ea.text: Tithe Cut gives 2.2 blood per MP it tears out instead of 2.
1.ea._not: engine-dev 2026-11-17 (Redtithe eşlemesi; Ömer onayı bekler, open-questions Q-NEW Redtithe): gainRatio 0,5 -> 0,6 (x1,2) -> bloodPerMp 2 -> 2,4 (x1,2). Eski metin: Mana Steal gains 60% of the MP it burns instead of 50%.

1.eb.name: Quickening Steal
1.eb.text: If Tithe Cut's target is at 0 MP, the ally with the least MP gains Haste for 1 turn.

1.ma.name: Drink Deep
1.ma.text: Tithe Cut also heals you for 12% of the MP it tears out.

1.fa.name: Drained Dry
1.fa.text: Tithe Cut tears out 100% more MP, but deals 50% less damage.

1.fb.name: Hurried Hands
1.fb.text: Tithe Cut takes only half a turn, but gains a 2-turn cooldown.

1.mb.name: Tempo Thief
1.mb.text: If Tithe Cut empties its target, your next turn comes 3.25% sooner.

1.v.name: Spellsplitter
1.v.text: Tithe Cut becomes Spellsplitter: it removes every buff from its target and deals 3.25% more damage per buff removed.

2.f1.name: Deep Taint
2.f1.text: Blood Brand's Bleeding deals 4% more damage per rank.
2.f1._not: engine-dev 2026-11-17 (Redtithe eşlemesi; Ömer onayı bekler, open-questions Q-NEW Redtithe): havuz rank başına +maks canın %2'si (taban %20'ye göre +%10) -> Brand Bleeding gücü rank başına +%10 (pct). 2.f2 / 2.f3 bu düğümü istediği için pasif bırakılamazdı. Eski metin: Ley Brand's tainted mana pool grows by 2% of max HP per rank.

2.f2.name: Searing Brand
2.f2.text: Tithe Cut and Exsanguinate deal a further 2% more damage per rank to Blood Branded enemies.
2.f2._not: engine-dev 2026-11-17 (Redtithe eşlemesi; Ömer onayı bekler, open-questions Q-NEW Redtithe): Brand yakım hasarı (burnDamagePct) -> Brand işaret hasarı (markDamagePct). Eski metin: Mana lost by a Branded enemy deals damage equal to a further 5% of that mana per rank.

2.f3.name: Heavy Toll
2.f3.text: Blood Branded enemies' MP costs rise by a further 5% per rank.
2.f3._not: engine-dev 2026-11-17 (Redtithe eşlemesi; Ömer onayı bekler, open-questions Q-NEW Redtithe): Aynı anlam (costMult). Eski metin: Branded enemies' MP costs rise by a further 5% per rank.

2.n0.name: Hush of the Brand
2.n0.text: When you empty a Blood Branded enemy's MP, it is Silenced for 1 turn.
2.n0._not: engine-dev 2026-11-20 (Ömer form r36 seçimi A): mpEmptied (her skill: Tithe Cut, Searing Grasp) + targetStatus blood_brand + Silence. Sayılar PROVİZYON. Eski: A Branded enemy whose mana reaches 0 is Silenced for 1 turn.

2.r.name: Widening Cut
2.r.text: Blood Brand's Bleeding deals 1.25% more damage per rank for each tick it has already dealt.
2.r._not: engine-dev 2026-11-20 (Ömer form r36 seçimi B): dot noktası powerMul x dotTickIndex (yalnız Blood Brand'in verdiği Bleeding: durumun fromSkill'i); ek tikler (Brand, yer değiştirme) de sayar ve güçlenir. Sayılar PROVİZYON. Eski: When Ley Brand runs out, leftover tainted mana deals damage equal to a further 10% of itself per rank.

2.ea.name: Deep Brand
2.ea.text: When a Blood Branded enemy uses a skill, its Bleeding ticks one more extra time.
2.ea._not: engine-dev 2026-11-20 (Ömer form r36 seçimi A): bloodBrand ticks +1. Sayılar PROVİZYON. Eski: The enemy in Ley Brand's centre cell gets a 50% larger tainted mana pool.

2.eb.name: Stripping Brand
2.eb.text: Blood Brand also removes one random buff from each enemy it hits.
2.eb._not: engine-dev 2026-11-20 (Ömer form r36 seçimi B): addEffect dispel buff count 1 random (Prying Blade dili; işaret tutmasa da isabet zarı yok: Blood Brand hasarsız). Sayılar PROVİZYON. Eski: Ley Brand covers one more column (3x3 → 3x4).

2.ma.name: Lasting Brand
2.ma._not: engine-dev 2026-11-17 (Redtithe eşlemesi; Ömer onayı bekler, open-questions Q-NEW Redtithe): Aynı anlam (işaret süresi). Eski metin: Ley Brand lasts 1 more turn.

2.fa.name: Heavy Brand
2.fa.text: Blood Branded enemies' MP costs are x2.5 instead of x1.5, but Blood Brand costs 10 more blood.
2.fa._not: engine-dev 2026-11-20 (Ömer form r36 seçimi A): bloodBrand costMult taban 2,5 (Ömer r36 notu: öneri 2 idi) + kan bedeli +10; 2.f3 eki tabanın üstüne. Sayılar PROVİZYON. Eski: Ley Brand hits only its centre cell, but that enemy's tainted mana pool is 40% of its max HP and its MP costs are doubled.

2.fb.name: Thin Brand
2.fb.text: Blood Brand costs 6 less blood, but lasts 1 turn less.
2.fb._not: engine-dev 2026-11-17 (Redtithe eşlemesi; Ömer onayı bekler, open-questions Q-NEW Redtithe): Aynı anlam (MP yerine kan bedeli). Eski metin: Ley Brand costs 6 less MP, but lasts 1 turn less.

2.mb.name: Searing Grasp
2.mb.text: Blood Brand also burns 6% of the max MP of each enemy it hits.
2.mb._not: engine-dev 2026-11-17 (Redtithe eşlemesi; Ömer onayı bekler, open-questions Q-NEW Redtithe): fx aynı (manaBurn pctMax 0,15); tainted mana kalktı. Eski metin: Ley Brand also burns 15% of each Branded enemy's max MP, tainted mana included.

2.v.name: Reaping Brand
2.v.text: Blood Brand becomes Reaping Brand: when its mark ends, the bearer takes 16% DEX damage and Blood Brand's cooldown resets.
2.v._not: engine-dev 2026-11-20 (Ömer form r36 seçimi A): statusEnd (mine, blood_brand; süre dolunca ya da silinince) + hasar + Blood Brand cooldown sıfırlama. Sayılar PROVİZYON. Eski: Ley Brand becomes Spreading Brand: when a Brand runs out, it leaps once to an unbranded enemy next to its bearer with a fresh Brand.

3.f1.name: Layered Ward
3.f1.text: Mirror Vein's shields are 1.5% larger per rank.
3.f1._not: engine-dev 2026-11-18 (Mirror Vein = Kan Örtüsü yeniden tasarımı; Ömer onayı bekler, open-questions Q-NEW Mirror Vein ağaç eşlemesi): yansıma payı +0,04 -> kalkan boyu +%4 (düz ek ve INT payı birlikte; asıl Spell Ward anlamı). Eski metin: Spell Ward's shield is 4% larger per rank.

3.f2.name: Ward Mending
3.f2.text: Mirror Vein also heals your lowest-HP ally for 1.5% of its max HP per rank when cast.
3.f2._not: engine-dev 2026-11-18 (Mirror Vein = Kan Örtüsü yeniden tasarımı; Ömer onayı bekler, open-questions Q-NEW Mirror Vein ağaç eşlemesi): Mirror Vein artık bütün takıma; 'hedef dost' yerine canı en düşük dost iyileşir (tek dost, eski güç).

3.f3.name: Spell-Proof Vein
3.f3.text: Allies under Mirror Vein take 0.5% less magic damage per rank.
3.f3._not: engine-dev 2026-11-20 (Ömer form r36 seçimi B): damageTaken who team, shield spell_ward, incomingType magic. Sayılar PROVİZYON. Eski: Spell Ward's shield takes +6% per rank from your remaining MP.

3.n0.name: Purging Ward
3.n0.text: Mirror Vein first removes every debuff from your lowest-HP ally that has one (you included). If Mirror Vein shields only you, it cleanses only you.
3.n0._not: Ömer 2026-11-20 (form r36, open-questions 542): silme, debuff'ı olan dostlar arasında canı (oran) en düşük olana, Redtithe dahil (canı en düşük dostta debuff yoksa sıradakine geçer; kimsede yoksa bir şey olmaz); Cloistered Ward (3.fb) alınmışsa yalnız Redtithe. Tek kural Battle.purgeTargetOf (motor, önizleme, YZ, ipucu). r35: yalnız canı en düşük dost (Ward Mending ile aynı seçim). Önce: 2026-11-18 bütün takım (before shield). Eski metin: Spell Ward first removes every debuff from the warded ally.

3.r.name: Shelter Echo
3.r.text: When a Mirror Vein shield breaks, its bearer heals 0.75% of its max HP per rank.
3.r._not: engine-dev 2026-11-20 (Ömer form r36 seçimi A): eski fx aynen (shieldBreak + heal subject); kalkan takımda olduğundan birkaç kez tetiklenebilir. Sayılar PROVİZYON. Eski: When Spell Ward breaks, the warded ally heals 2% of its max HP per rank.

3.ea.name: Long Vein
3.ea.text: Mirror Vein's shields last 1 turn longer.
3.ea._not: engine-dev 2026-11-20 (Ömer form r36 seçimi A): shield turns +1. Sayılar PROVİZYON. Eski: Spell Ward also wards the ally with the least MP at 25% strength.

3.eb.name: Ward Taunt
3.eb.text: When Mirror Vein shields you, you also taunt all enemies for 1 turn.
3.eb._not: engine-dev 2026-11-18 (Mirror Vein = Kan Örtüsü yeniden tasarımı; Ömer onayı bekler, open-questions Q-NEW Mirror Vein ağaç eşlemesi): koşul (targetIsSelf) aynı; skill bütün takıma (kendisi dahil) olduğundan her atışta tutar.

3.ma.name: Blood for Blood
3.ma.text: When a Mirror Vein shield absorbs a spell, the caster Bleeds for 2 turns (6% DEX per turn).
3.ma._not: engine-dev 2026-11-20 (Ömer form r36 seçimi A): shieldAbsorb + incomingType magic + Bleeding (alıcı büyüyü atan). Sayılar PROVİZYON. Eski: When Spell Ward breaks, a 25% ward forms on the ally with the lowest HP.

3.fa.name: Opened Veins
3.fa.text: Mirror Vein's shields are 16% larger, but it costs 10 more blood.
3.fa._not: engine-dev 2026-11-20 (Ömer form r36 seçimi A): kalkan power / flat +%40 + kan bedeli +10. Sayılar PROVİZYON. Eski: Split Ward is full strength, but Spell Ward costs 18 MP.

3.fb.name: Cloistered Ward
3.fb.text: Mirror Vein shields only you, but your shield is 60% larger and Mirror Vein costs 10 less blood.
3.fb._not: engine-dev 2026-11-18 (Mirror Vein = Kan Örtüsü yeniden tasarımı; Ömer onayı bekler, open-questions Q-NEW Mirror Vein ağaç eşlemesi): yansıma %30 -> kalkan boyu %30 (asıl anlam), skill yalnız kendine. Eski metin: Spell Ward on yourself is 30% larger, but it can no longer target allies.

3.mb.name: Bastion of Null
3.mb.text: While you hold Mirror Vein's shield and a taunt, you take 12% less physical damage.
3.mb._not: engine-dev 2026-11-18 (Mirror Vein = Kan Örtüsü yeniden tasarımı; Ömer onayı bekler, open-questions Q-NEW Mirror Vein ağaç eşlemesi): selfStatus mirror_vein -> selfHasShield spell_ward (asıl biçime dönüş; kalkan süreli katman olduğundan koşul kalkan sürdükçe tutar). Eski metin: While you hold Spell Ward and a taunt, you take 30% less physical damage.

3.v.name: Mirror Ward
3.v.text: Mirror Vein becomes Mirror Ward: spells its shields absorb are thrown back at the caster for 10% of the absorbed damage.
3.v._not: engine-dev 2026-11-20 (Ömer form r36 seçimi A): eski fx aynen (shieldAbsorb magic, emilen miktarın %25 hasarı saldırana); yansıtma dönüşümde geri geliyor, Ömer bilerek seçti. Sayılar PROVİZYON. Eski: Spell Ward becomes Mirror Ward: magic hits it absorbs are thrown back at the attacker for 25% of their damage.

4.u1.name: Crippling Void
4.u1.text: Exsanguinate Blinds its target for 1 turn.

4.u2.name: Spell Shatter
4.u2.text: Exsanguinate's target deals 8% less magic damage for 2 turns.

4.u3.name: Void Shackle
4.u3.text: Exsanguinate Stuns its target if it is at 0 MP.

4.r2.name: Shared Spoils
4.r2.text: Allies that hit the Overextended target gain 2 MP.

4.r3.name: Feeding Frenzy
4.r3.text: If an ally kills Exsanguinate's target before its next turn, your team gains 6 MP.

4.d1.name: Swift Void
4.d1.text: Exsanguinate takes only half a turn.

4.d2.name: Ready Blades
4.d2.text: After Exsanguinate, your next Tithe Cut strikes an extra time.

4.d3.name: Threaded Void
4.d3.text: After Exsanguinate, your next turn comes 4% sooner.
4.d3._not: engine-dev 2026-11-17 (Redtithe eşlemesi; Ömer onayı bekler, open-questions Q-NEW Redtithe): Ley Thread bırakma kısmı kalktı (iplik yok); yalnız tur öne alma kaldı. Eski metin: Void Strike leaves a Ley Thread on its target for 2 turns, and your next turn comes 10% sooner.

4.l1.name: Rallying Break
4.l1.text: If Exsanguinate's target had a buff, your team gains Haste for 1 turn.

4.l2.name: Turned Boons
4.l2.text: Allies hasted by Rallying Break also gain 2 MP.

4.l3.name: Grand Theft
